scripts.test: tsx --test tests/*.test.ts && node --conditions=react-server --import tsx --test tests/audio/*.test.ts tests/scoring/*.test.ts
scripts.setup: npm run db:start && prisma generate && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.audio:virtual: tsc src/lib/audio-capture.ts src/lib/microphone.ts --target ES2022 --module ES2022 --outDir .local/virtual-mic --skipLibCheck && node scripts/audio-virtual-server.mjs
scripts.quality:check: ASSESSMENT_ENVIRONMENT=isolated-local ASSESSMENT_PROVIDER=local PROFILE_PROVIDER=local AUDIO_WORKER_ENABLED=false OPENAI_API_KEY= node --conditions=react-server --import tsx scripts/quality-check.ts
